_about: QBEAST AI circuit & liquidity flags - configuration. Keys starting with '_' are comments. Leave a key out to keep its default. Full reference: README.md section 5. v2.4.3 adds: STEP staircase, separate ETF rules (*_etf sections), separate climbing / falling settings, owner volume rule (OHLC only when volume is zero / missing / unreliable), corporate-action guard, optional traded-value floor. legacy_v242_config() = exactly v2.4.2.

paths._help: Where the data lives. data_dir can also be overridden per run with --data.
paths._etfs_eod_subdir: v2.4.3. ETF EOD folder inside data_dir (e.g. "Final_ETF_EoD_Data"); null = run_four_flags does not process ETFs. ETF rows use the *_etf rule sections.
paths._mwcb_index_files: Index files (inside the indices folders) used for MWCB. NIFTY50 also provides the trading calendar. Missing files are skipped.
paths._output_dir: null = write outputs inside data_dir; or a folder path.

run._help: Parallel runs. workers = processes (e.g. 25 on a 16-core/32-thread CPU). check_every = run the causality self-check on 1 in N stocks (1 = all, 0 = off).
run._mp_start_method: null = platform default (spawn on Windows). Only change for debugging.

circuit._help: Flag 2 Upper/Lower Circuit (and the causal band inference used for Flag 1 when no band data is supplied).
circuit._lock_mode: close_locked = close at high (upper) / low (lower); strict = open = high = low = close.
circuit._tick_size: Exchange tick in rupees; tolerance = 1 tick / prev_close + tol.
circuit._infer_band: true = infer the band causally when no upper_band_pct/lower_band_pct columns are given.
circuit._min_band_ticks: A band narrower than this many ticks is 'tick_degenerate' (penny stock): reported, never feeds Staircase/Chronic.
circuit._offgrid_max_slack_pct: Cap on the tolerance for prices off the 0.05 grid (back-adjusted / fine-tick data).
circuit._intraday: Intraday only: a freeze = pinned at the band for >= intraday_min_pinned_bars consecutive bars.
circuit._intraday_candidate_mode: true = when the session band is unknown, test every candidate band intraday (causes false freezes on large caps).
circuit._volume_quality: v2.4.2. true = zero volume on a bar whose price moved (H>L, or close/open != previous close), or the zero_run_missing-th consecutive zero/blank-volume session so far, is MISSING volume (no data), not a no-trade day. Blank / negative / infinite volume is always MISSING. false = v2.4.1.
circuit._ca_jump_pct: v2.4.3. Corporate-action guard: a close-to-close move larger than this % that is not at a matched band (split / bonus / ETF unit split) is ca_suspect: staircase and STEP hold their state on it and it does not feed the band inference. null = off (v2.4.2).

staircase._help: Flag 4 Staircase. Tagged on the S-th consecutive same-direction ladder day; untagged after E consecutive NORMAL days.
staircase._vol_frac: null = no thin-volume requirement for a ladder day; e.g. 0.1 = ladder day volume must be < 10% of baseline.
staircase._volume_lookback: Clean trading days in the volume baseline (median).
staircase._normal_vol_frac: A NORMAL (untagging) day needs volume >= this x baseline.
staircase._intraday_early_block: Block intraday when yesterday closed at S-1 ladder days and every bar today is pinned in that direction.
staircase._vol_avg_days: v2.4.2. Trailing average of REAL volume over this many sessions (a ZERO no-trade session counts as 0, MISSING sessions are skipped); used for the tag and the untag. 1 = v2.4.1 (the day's own volume).
staircase._tag_vol_frac: v2.4.2. Tag on the S-th (or later) ladder day only if that average < tag_vol_frac x baseline (illiquid ladder). null = v2.4.1 (no volume test for the tag).
staircase._missing_volume_fallback: v2.4.2. When the day's volume is MISSING (or no baseline yet), tag / untag are decided on OHLC only and the bar gets STAIRCASE_VOL_WARN. false = v2.4.1 (no untag without volume).
staircase._step: v2.4.3 STEP staircase: illiquid 'flat, then jump' (stocks AND ETFs, no exchange band needed). Blocks like a staircase (TRADE_BLOCKED reason STEP_STAIRCASE). A STALE bar = close == previous close AND no real trading (volume zero, or real volume < step_stale_vol_frac x baseline, or a single-price bar; missing volume -> price only, warned). TAG on step_tag_stale_run stale bars in a row, OR when a STEP event (first non-stale bar after >= step_min_stale stale bars, |move| >= step_jump_pct %) brings the events of the last step_window bars to >= step_events_to_tag. UNTAG after step_end_confirm_days NORMAL bars (price moved, average real volume back >= normal_vol_frac x baseline). step_enabled false = exactly v2.4.2.
staircase._step_exempt_pattern: v2.4.3. Optional regex on the symbol (case-insensitive): matching symbols never get a STEP tag, e.g. "LIQUID|OVERNIGHT" for constant-NAV liquid / overnight ETFs whose price is flat by design. null = no exemption.
staircase._zero_volume_as_missing: v2.4.3 owner rule: decisions use REAL volume; a session with ZERO volume carries no volume information -> tag / untag / STEP on OHLC with a warning (false = v2.4.2: zero counts as volume 0).
staircase._vol_reliability: v2.4.3. When fewer than vol_reliability_min of the last vol_reliability_window sessions have REAL volume (typical before 2010), the volume is treated as unreliable -> OHLC basis, staircase_vol_reason UNRELIABLE. null = off.
staircase._direction: v2.4.3. Separate CLIMBING (upper band) / FALLING (lower band) settings; null = use the shared value above. tag_vol_frac_*: 0 = no volume test. ladder_break_days: non-ladder sessions tolerated while a ladder is BUILDING (0 = v2.4.2: any break resets).

chronic._help: Chronic illiquidity (part of TRADE_BLOCKED). Trailing window of sessions; tag at enter_*, untag only when all measures < exit_*.
chronic._missing_volume_as_no_trade: v2.4.2. false = a MISSING-volume session counts as traded (unknown volume), not as a no-trade session. true = v2.4.1.
chronic._min_traded_value: v2.4.3. Optional absolute floor in Rs: chronic also when the median traded value (close x REAL volume) of the last traded_value_window REAL-volume sessions < min_traded_value; released at >= min_traded_value x traded_value_exit_mult. null = off (v2.4.2).

_etf_sections: v2.4.3. Separate rules for ETFs: list ONLY the keys whose ETF value differs from the stock section (same key names). Empty = ETFs use the stock rules. Asset class per file from its product_class / asset_class column (ETF vs EQUITY).

mwcb._help: Flag 3 MWCB. Trigger = index intraday extreme vs reference close crosses a level.
mwcb._basis: auto = previous quarter's last close before quarterly_basis_before, previous day's close after; or prev_close / quarterly.
mwcb._halt_rules: Per level: list of [until HH:MM, halt minutes]; null = halt for the rest of the day, 0 = no halt.

gate._help: TRADE_BLOCKED gate. block_on_mwcb_day = true also blocks decisions taken at the close of an MWCB day (next open).
